# Helvety Tasks

> Task management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields in current supported flows. Uses a flat, item-first workflow with immutable built-in stage and label sets plus drag-and-drop ordering. Engineered and designed in Switzerland.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://helvety.com/tasks): Task management app with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- Access model: free to use with no business/account quotas

## Helvety Ecosystem
- [Helvety](https://helvety.com): Main Helvety website with company information and legal pages
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Official catalog for Helvety products and package downloads (all Helvety apps are free to use)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Free PDF toolkit with browser-based processing for supported operations
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth): Centralized authentication for all Helvety apps
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Contact management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes): Notes management with client-side encryption for sensitive fields

## Optional
- [GitHub](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Public monorepo for all Helvety applications (open source under MIT)
